description: Connect Loreo's private meeting memory to ChatGPT. Search authorized transcripts by meaning, retrieve notes and cited passages, collect action items, find prior conversations with people, export meeting text, and ask questions across your meeting history. Loreo is read-only in ChatGPT and honors account consent, per-meeting exclusions, encryption boundaries, workspace permissions, and audit logging.

defaultPrompt: What are my action items from recent meetings?
Where did we decide to keep Ask as a separate tab?
Prepare me for my next call using our meeting history.
